papers.title: Microstructure and compression behavior of Ti-6Al-4V and AlSi10Mg X-type lattice structure fabricated by additive manufacturing
papers.abstract: Although the development of novel metal lattice structures presents an effective pathway for component lightweight and cost efficiency, challenging still exists in the matching of material selection with structure design. In this work, the microstructures and compressive properties of X-type lattice structures made of Ti-6Al-4V and AlSi10Mg by selective laser melting (SLM) were investigated. Through a comparative analysis of microstructure characterization, macroscopic fracture, and finite element (FE) simulations of the quasi-static compression process, the underlying deformation mechanisms of them are elucidated. It demonstrates that the Ti-6Al-4V lattice structure failed by shear fracture at the support rod nodes, whereas the AlSi10Mg lattice underwent progressive plastic collapse. The results indicate that the Ti6Al-4V structure had a superior load-bearing capacity, while the AlSi10Mg structure exhibited a distinct advantage in energy absorption. This research paves a theoretical and practical approach for material selection and the lightweight design of lattice structures.

llm.relevance_to_user: 本文研究了Ti-6Al-4V点阵结构的压缩性能，但与股骨柄植入物的具体设计、应力屏蔽或疲劳性能无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address femoral stem design, implant-specific metrics (stress shielding, micromotion, fatigue), or any orthopaedic context; it is a general lattice compression study without implant application.

summary_zh.motivation: 探索不同材料点阵结构的轻量化和成本效益，匹配材料与结构设计。
summary_zh.method: 通过SLM制备Ti-6Al-4V和AlSi10Mg X型点阵，进行微观表征、压缩实验和有限元模拟。
summary_zh.result: Ti-6Al-4V点阵在节点剪切断裂，AlSi10Mg逐步塑性坍塌；前者承载能力更强，后者能量吸收更好。
summary_zh.validation: 通过实验压缩测试和有限元模拟对比验证。

summary_en.motivation: This work aims to explore the lightweight design and cost efficiency of lattice structures by comparing two different materials fabricated by selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: X-type lattice structures of Ti-6Al-4V and AlSi10Mg were fabricated by SLM and characterized via microstructure analysis, quasi-static compression tests, and finite element simulations.
summary_en.result: The Ti-6Al-4V lattice failed by shear fracture at nodes, while AlSi10Mg exhibited progressive plastic collapse; Ti-6Al-4V showed superior load-bearing capacity, and AlSi10Mg had better energy absorption.
summary_en.validation: Experimental compression tests and finite element simulations were used to validate the deformation mechanisms.
